FX-DRIZZLE-001.says: As added: ten drops a second, each ripple spreading for a second to a radius of an eighth of the picture's height (4 pixels here), two rings, lit from the top left: at frame 0 no drop yet, the still water lit evenly; at frames 13 and 25 small rings over the picture.

FX-DRIZZLE-002.says: Four drops a second spreading to 24 pixels, Displacement 200, unlit: the picture bent by wide rings and untouched between them; frame 8 has one young ripple, frame 20 three.

FX-DRIZZLE-003.says: FX-DRIZZLE-002 lit as added: the rings stand out, lighter on the sides facing the top-left light.

FX-DRIZZLE-005.says: Rippling 1080: four rings a ripple, closer together.

FX-DRIZZLE-006.says: Displacement 0: the picture is not bent, only lit by the rings.

FX-DRIZZLE-008.says: Ripple Height 0: still water, so unlit the picture is untouched.

FX-DRIZZLE-009.says: Ripple Height -100: the rings dip where they rose, twice as deep.

FX-DRIZZLE-010.says: Longevity 0.5: each ripple spreads in half a second and is gone, so fewer live at once.

FX-DRIZZLE-011.says: Longevity 0: no ripple lives; unlit, the picture untouched.

FX-DRIZZLE-012.says: Drip Rate 0: no drops; unlit, the picture untouched.

FX-DRIZZLE-013.says: Drip Rate keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 24 at frame 12: by frame 11 five drops have been born, the rate summed from the in point.

FX-DRIZZLE-014.says: Longevity keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 0.25 at frame 12: it is read at the in point only, so the same as FX-DRIZZLE-002.

FX-DRIZZLE-015.says: FX-DRIZZLE-002 with the layer starting at frame 6: frame 14 is 002's frame 8 and frame 26 its frame 20, because the drops start at the in point.

FX-DRIZZLE-016.says: FX-DRIZZLE-003 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-DRIZZLE-017.says: FX-DRIZZLE-002 at 30 frames a second: frame 14 is seven fifteenths of a second in, not seven twelfths.

FX-DRIZZLE-018.says: A point light at the middle, 10 pixels up: the water brightest under it and darker towards the corners.

FX-DRIZZLE-019.says: An orange light, Specular 100, Roughness 0.5, Metal 0, Diffuse 0: broad highlights in the light's own orange on the rings.

FX-DRIZZLE-020.says: The picture with its right half clear: the clear half stays clear except where a ring bends the picture across the edge.

FX-DRIZZLE-021.says: Light Direction 135, from the bottom right: the other sides of the rings light.

FX-DRIZZLE-022.says: Spreading 0: no ripple has a size; lit as added, the still water.

FX-DRIZZLE-023.says: Spreading keyed from 300 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 12: every live ripple takes the spreading as it is now, so at frame 14 all are a third the size of FX-DRIZZLE-002's.

FX-DRIZZLE-024.says: Thirty drops a second, Rippling 720, lit as added: a downpour.

FX-DRIZZLE-025.says: Drip Rate -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-026.says: Drip Rate 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-027.says: Longevity 101, above 100 seconds. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-028.says: Rippling 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-029.says: Displacement 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-030.says: Ripple Height -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-031.says: Spreading 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-032.says: Roughness 0, below 0.001. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DRIZZLE-033.says: A light type written "spot". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
